messages:
Asha CS: Quick sync — Juniper go-live is currently gated. Proposal: staggered quota windows + client regen fallback. Need ops + eng-sre + customer sign-off before we flip traffic.
Marta SRE: Sounds reasonable. Can we define the windows precisely and a burn-in plan? e.g., 09:00-11:00 25% quota, 11:00-14:00 50%, 14:00-18:00 full.
Tom Platform: I can set the quota windows and an autoscale policy that scales more aggressively in the 11-14 slot. Need the exact threshold numbers (qps, token rate).
Lucas CS: From Juniper: they want faster ramp if KPIs look good. Sam — are you ok with the stagger above? Any customer-side rate-limiting we should account for?
Sam (Juniper): 25/50/full is fine as a starting point. We'll limit client retries to 3 and exponential backoff. If 50% looks stable, we can opt into a fast path.
Jess Eng: Let's add a regen fallback route — if tail latency > 400ms for 3 consecutive mins, route 30% of requests to a smaller quantized model. That buys headroom.
Marta SRE: Agreed. I'll add a healthcheck that flips a flag when p95 > 350ms for 2 mins; autoscaler will react and deploy extra qps workers.
Tom Platform: I'll set autoscale target to 70% GPU util, max burst +30% for 20m, and configure the quota windows. Also adding per-customer token cap to avoid noisy neighbors.
Asha CS: We should run a controlled burn-in today. Marta — can you run three sequential bursts: 500rps x10m, 1k rps x15m, 1.5k rps x10m against staging pool? Keep logs of 95/99 latencies and OOMs.
Marta SRE: Yep. I'll run from the eu-west staging pool at 15:30 UTC.
Jess Eng: Load test command for reference:
```
# run from k8s job
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-3-small","input":"token test","max_tokens":128}' --rate 1000/s
```
Marta SRE: I'll attach the script and raw results to this thread after the run. Expect a short spike during the 1.5k run; we'll watch p99 and model OOM counts.
deploy-bot: smoke-run scheduled by Marta SRE for 2024-09-08T15:30:00Z — will post completion status.
Lucas CS: Ops ask: please confirm billing/legal for quota overshoot in burst window. Asha, can you confirm terms with Juniper?
Asha CS: On it — I'll confirm contract language around burst allowances and notify finance.
Sam (Juniper): Thanks — we'll standby. If you want, we can enable client-side sampling to reduce pressure during early windows.
Jess Eng: Also adding a quick rollback play: if error rate > 2% for 5m, we revert traffic to canary and lower quotas by 40%.
Marta SRE: Run done. Attaching quick summary: 500rps stable p95=120ms, 1krps p95=210ms, 1.5krps p95=380ms with a few transient 500ms spikes; no OOMs. Full logs: /mnt/staging/loadtests/juniper-2024-09-08.log
Asha CS: Great — thanks team. Action items: Tom configure autoscale + quota windows, Marta upload full logs and alerts, Jess add regen fallback flag, Lucas confirm billing, I will finalize customer sign-off. :thumbsup:
